article.title: Observe.AI公布跨AI與人工客服的即時監督工具
article.title_en: Observe.AI announces live supervision across AI and human service
article.summary: Observe.AI推出Agent Overwatch，監察支援的AI代理及人工客服對話，並把需關注的互動通知主管。
article.summary_en: Observe.AI introduced Agent Overwatch to monitor supported AI and human conversations and alert supervisors to interactions needing attention.
highlights: 企業可設定風險及升級條件，經支援的Slack或Teams渠道接收告警。
主管可查看逐字稿；旁聽、加入通話等介入方式視渠道及整合而定。
highlights_en: Enterprises configure risk and escalation criteria, with supported Slack or Teams alerts.
Supervisors can access transcripts; listening or joining depends on channel and integration support.
article.why: 多家AI供應商的客服對話可放在同一監督流程評估，客戶體驗團隊可決定哪些失敗互動須即時轉交主管。
article.why_en: Customer-experience teams can define which failed interactions across multiple AI providers need a supervisor during the conversation.
article.next_step: 以一項反覆誤解的售前查詢，核對告警原因、逐字稿及可介入渠道，確認客戶是否需要重新交代問題。
article.next_step_en: Check the alert reason, transcript and intervention channel for a repeated pre-sales misunderstanding.
article.detail: 公告列出的訊號包括未授權要求、重複誤解及自動流程失敗。這些訊號供主管判斷是否接手，並非每一項告警都代表已發生事故。團隊可從現有服務渠道挑選具體場景，確認支援的代理、通知工具及主管動作，再安排誰負責處理不同等級的升級。公告描述的是監督機制，成效仍需按團隊自己的服務記錄評估。
article.detail_en: Signals include unauthorized requests, repeated misunderstandings and failed automation. An alert is a prompt for judgment rather than proof of an incident. Map supported agents, notification tools and supervisor actions for specific service scenarios before assigning escalation responsibilities.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
